messages:
elaine: Heads-up — I opened a docs PR for the on-prem installer network section. It adds KMS/HSM firewall snippets and a small FAQ for air-gapped installs. Need a quick review on the port list and the PKCS#11 notes.

sam: Thanks! Can you paste the nftables example here so I can smoke-test it against our internal lab? Want to confirm the rules are minimal.

elaine: Sure, pasted from the PR:
```
# allow KMS management and HSM PKCS11
add table inet redwood
add chain inet redwood input { type filter hook input priority 0; }
add rule inet redwood input tcp dport 16992 accept   # KMS admin
add rule inet redwood input tcp dport 16993 accept   # KMS admin TLS
add rule inet redwood input udp dport 9876 accept    # HSM vendor heartbeat
add rule inet redwood input tcp dport 5555 accept    # PKCS11 proxy
```
I also added a note that customers using vendor HSMs might need extra ephemeral UDP ports — linked to vendor docs.

irina: Small wording nit: replace "admin" with "management API" and add one sentence about egress requirements for the installer to reach S3-like blobstore (if using online bundle). Otherwise looks good.

mike: @elaine also add a tiny snippet for iptables users? We still see some customers on older kernels. Could be one-liner mapping to the nft rules.

elaine: Good call. I added an iptables equivalent and a small example to disable conntrack for the PKCS11 stream (some HSM proxies misbehave). Example:
```
# iptables example
iptables -A INPUT -p tcp --dport 16992 -j ACCEPT
iptables -A INPUT -p tcp --dport 16993 -j ACCEPT
iptables -A INPUT -p tcp --dport 5555 -j ACCEPT
# disable conntrack for PKCS11
iptables -t raw -A PREROUTING -p tcp --dport 5555 -j NOTRACK
```

sam: Great. I ran both in the lab — they work but droplet images need kernel module nf_conntrack_bypass for NOTRACK on some older distros. Added that as a troubleshooting bullet.

devdocs-bot: PR 4821: docs/onprem/networking.md — elaine requested reviewers: @sam @irina @mike. Status: changes requested (1) — add management API wording; (2) include egress note. Link: https://redwood.internal/pulls/4821 :gear:

irina: I left two very small edits inline (grammar + link to vendor HSM port matrix). Also can we add a migration note for customers moving from older HSM proxy (v1) to proxy v2? The v2 uses a different admin port (5566) so call that out.

elaine: Added migration note and port mapping table. Also linked the offline bundle checksum section for air-gapped installers. I kept the KMS key rotation paragraph separated so it doesn't look like a networking requirement.

mike: One more ask — include the SDK snippet for initializing PKCS11 from the installer host (node example). I mocked a tiny Go example earlier, want to paste:
```
// go: use pkcs11 library to open session
p := pkcs11.New("/usr/local/lib/yourhsm.so")
_ = p.Initialize()
sess, _ := p.OpenSession(slot, pkcs11.CKF_SERIAL_SESSION)
_ = p.Login(sess, pkcs11.CKU_USER, "pin")
```

elaine: Perfect, added that to the SDK examples section and referenced the PKCS11 vendor guide. Also added a short note: "If using air-gapped installer, ensure the HSM vendor libs are pre-bundled into the offline image." :lock:

ops-bot: Reminder — if anyone updates the port list, please file a security review ticket for network change approval (sec-req-127).

sam: Will do a follow-up pass tomorrow to check wording and run the quick smoke tests again. If all good I'll approve the PR. :thumbsup:

elaine: Thanks everyone — aiming to merge by EOD tomorrow after CI and the lab check. If you want to test locally, see the test script I added: https://redwood.internal/ci/onprem-net-tests.sh
